settings.heading: Keep Your Sofa Looking Its Best
settings.body_text: Smart, simple upkeep for every material. Follow these routines to protect comfort, colour and character — for the long run.

settings.heading: Built To Last — With A Little Love
settings.body: Every Sofa Direct piece is designed for everyday living. Our care tips are organised by material, with extra guidance on stains, cushions and the environment around your sofa.

settings.title: Genuine Leather
settings.text: Clean gently, condition occasionally, and avoid harsh chemicals.
settings.list1:
Weekly dusting with a soft, dry cloth
Gentle vacuuming with soft brush attachment
Blot spills immediately with a damp cloth
settings.list2:
Baby wipes, multi-surface sprays, bleach
Harsh chemicals or abrasive cloths
Extended direct sunlight
Sharp objects and pet claws

settings.title: Bonded Leather
settings.text: Keep it dry, clean gently, never saturate.
settings.list1:
Weekly wipe with a soft, damp cloth
Mild soap diluted in water if needed
Dry immediately with a clean cloth
settings.list2:
Over-saturation
Solvent-based cleaners
Direct heat sources

settings.title: Leather Aire (PU)
settings.text: Low maintenance — benefits from regular, gentle care.
settings.list1:
Regular wipe with a soft, damp cloth
Mild soap and water when necessary
Dry thoroughly after cleaning
settings.list2:
Sharp objects and friction
Alcohol or solvent-based cleaners
Heat and prolonged sunlight

settings.title: Fabric Sofas
settings.text: A weekly vacuum keeps fabrics fresh and lifted.
settings.list1:
Weekly vacuum with a soft upholstery attachment
Rotate and plump cushions regularly
Remove crumbs and dust promptly
settings.list2:
Blot spills immediately — never rub
Use an appropriate upholstery cleaner
Test in a hidden area first

settings.title: Stain Management
settings.list1:
Act quickly on spills
Blot — don't rub
Never mix cleaning chemicals
Call a professional for stubborn stains

settings.title: Cushion Care
settings.list1:
Rotate seat cushions weekly
Swap left and right cushions
Plump fibre-filled cushions daily
Foam softening over time is normal

settings.title: Environment
settings.list1:
Indoor humidity between 40–60%
Avoid placement near damp windows
Ensure good ventilation
Limit extreme temperature swings

settings.title: Pet Considerations
settings.list1:
Prevent scratching and chewing
Use throws for frequent-use spots
Keep sharp items away from upholstery

settings.heading: Keep your warranty in shape
settings.body: Retain your purchase receipt, fire-safety label and delivery care instructions. Improper care may affect warranty coverage.
